text:
Correct this unexecuted proposal using the existing explicit structural revision path, limited to data adaptation and the diagnosed guards. Preserve accepted requirements and public inputs/outputs exactly, including non-null product records with nullable missing fields, the first at most ten products in observed order, the fixed workbook path, actual search/navigation, every selected product visit, actual Document writing and Browser cleanup. Preserve all external operation identities and their relative execution order. Do not add business filtering, deduplication or fabricated data.
1. Fix open_amazon_search.requires and read_product_page.requires as genuine typed boolean predicates over their existing inputs, e.g. explicit not-null checks, not string values. Keep mandatory runtime assertions. The search URL must actually include the public query, with correct URL encoding, without json(string) (which produces quoted JSON text). Use a small explicit interpretation only if existing typed bindings cannot construct the encoded URL; the output is one required URL string derived solely from query.
2. flatten_rows currently flattens an array of row objects. Use value with a direct reference to visit_each_product.rows; flatten only actual arrays of arrays. Preserve the validated public row shape and maxItems=10. Do not use extraction to copy already typed rows.
3. Replace raw observationSnapshot inputs to global interpret with the existing composition: complete snapshot checks, extract.each over its bounded complete pages into a narrow resultType, foreach each typed page view to export its candidate arrays, one-level flatten, compact interpretation returning observed candidate IDs, lookup against offered candidates, then lookup against original observed records. Use field only on objects within item scopes. Process all pages/records, retain original action URLs/references separately, and obtain navigation arguments from the original records. Prefer observed producer reference identities; never invent IDs or URLs. Global decision inputs contain only identity and necessary observed decision text, never whole snapshots or action-only payloads. Keep selection to the first at most ten products matching the query in observed order, with no sponsored filtering or deduplication.
4. Within each actual product visit, independently extract compact observed name/description/price facts per complete page and reconcile only these compact facts if needed. Never send whole product snapshots to global interpretation; retain all original observations and completeness metadata. Missing fields remain null in non-null rows and observed errors remain explicit. Keep one bounded TSV formatting transform over at most ten compact rows, then real Document writing. Return filePath and success from the actual writer result; no literals substituting for external work.
Use only currently available TaskPlan constructs and inspected operation contracts. The revision may add the necessary adaptation tasks but must not change accepted requirements, permissions, limits, external operations or cleanup. Do not author scripts or introduce new public inputs.
